reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis merely restates the goal without specifying any concrete physical model, mechanism, or computational method, making it scientifically hollow.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is circular (using the new approach to validate itself) and lacks a decisive, independent experimental or computational falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: It offers no actionable insight, novel mechanism, or specific predictive framework, so it does not help a researcher advance beyond the stated constraints.
